items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: My sister boy. That was my sister boy. Warren, isn't he? Warren. Oh yeah. He plays sax.

ctx.x: You remember the day when they were making the television movie around the world? The television movie around at the Jean Zanet? You brought a boy over there with you? I think he's your nephew or something. He plays music. You introduced me to this young guy. I know him, but I can't think of his name. I'm not doing it. I might just be a friend of yours. I don't know. I don't know.
My sister boy. That was my sister boy. Warren, isn't he? Warren. Oh yeah. He plays sax. He from Booker Teele School. What's your name, Warren's what?
Warren Glass. Did the white people follow Zulu in the old days when you were young? Oh, from the time I seen them, they used to come out and look.
